newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica names new management members.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica names new management members.

text.p: Spain's Telefonica has completed changes to its management, naming two new director generals and a new secretary, the firm said in a statement late Wednesday.

Jose Maria Mas has been named secretary general of the board and the executive committee. Francisco de Bergia is now director general of institutional relations and Juan Jose Nieto is director general of projects and international alliances.
Former institutional relations director Andres Tejero becomes director of purchases and assets, and former international director Francisco Mochon goes to head the cost control department.
Ignacio de Benito has been named director general of Telefonica Internacional (TISA), the firm's foreign arm.
